---
title: "neuronal unique marker gene combination id and cluster naming"
output: html_document
date: "2025-03-13"
---

Stratify by neurotransmitter and neuropeptides/receptors: name celltypes by nps expressed (thresholded to 25% of max np expression to filter out lowly expressed nps since many celltypes express nps at low levels), neurotransmitter expressed (slc17a6 or slc32a1), unless there's a canonical name. 

Load final neuron assignments
```{r setup}
library(magrittr)
library(BPCells)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scattermore)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(dplyr)
library(bluster)
library(cluster)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplotify)
library(khroma)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(biomaRt)
library(collapse)
library(ROI)
library(ROI.plugin.glpk)
library(ompr)
library(ompr.roi)

cluster_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
np_fraction_of_max_threshold = .25
set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
neuropeptide_and_receptors_df= read_csv("./Neuropeptide_and_receptors.csv")
#tidy so have 
peptides = neuropeptide_and_receptors_df$Neuropeptide %>% unique()
receptors = neuropeptide_and_receptors_df$`Neuropeptide Receptor` %>% str_split(",") %>% unlist() %>% unique()
peptides_and_receptors = c(peptides, receptors) %>% unique
```

load ge, cpm normalize, filter for nps/recep.
```{r}

ge = open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")
ge = ge[,names(cluster_assignments)] #filter for neuronal cells
norm_ge = multiply_cols(ge, 1/Matrix::colSums(ge)) 
norm_ge = norm_ge * 1e6

#subset nps and receptors
peptides_and_receptors = peptides_and_receptors[peptides_and_receptors %in% rownames(norm_ge)]

#add go terms
ensembl <- useEnsembl("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")
gpcr_go <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "external_gene_name", "mgi_id", "description"),
  filters = "go",
  values = "GO:0004930", #G protein-coupled receptor activity gene set
  mart = ensembl
)
#remove olfactory genes + vomeronasal + taste
cur_df_filtered <- gpcr_go[!grepl("olfactory", gpcr_go$description, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
cur_df_filtered <- cur_df_filtered[!grepl("vomeronasal", cur_df_filtered$description, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
cur_df_filtered <- cur_df_filtered[!grepl("taste", cur_df_filtered$description, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
cur_df_filtered <- cur_df_filtered[!grepl("predicted", cur_df_filtered$description, ignore.case = TRUE), ]


new_gene_list = c(peptides_and_receptors, cur_df_filtered$external_gene_name) %>% unique %>% .[. %in% rownames(norm_ge)]

norm_ge_nps = norm_ge[new_gene_list,]

#aggregate per cluster
nps_pseudobulk = pseudobulk_matrix(norm_ge_nps, cell_groups = cluster_assignments, method = "mean", threads = 8L)

#get 25% of max np exp for each cluster
threshold_exp_each_np = rowMaxs(nps_pseudobulk) * np_fraction_of_max_threshold
#if any has less than 10 cpm, set that as threshold 
threshold_exp_each_np[threshold_exp_each_np < 10] = 10

#if any has greater than 100 cpm, ste that as threshold
threshold_exp_each_np[threshold_exp_each_np > 100] = 100
```
split into glut, gaba, both, or neither based on 25% exp level
```{r}
percent_cluster_exp_gaba_glut= pseudobulk_matrix(ge[c("Slc17a6","Slc32a1"),] > 0, cell_groups = cluster_assignments, method = "mean", threads = 8L)
slc17_celltypes = percent_cluster_exp_gaba_glut["Slc17a6",] %>% .[. > .25] %>% names()
slc32_celltypes = percent_cluster_exp_gaba_glut["Slc32a1",] %>% .[. > .25] %>% names()
slc17_and_slc32_celltypes = intersect(slc17_celltypes, slc32_celltypes)
slc17_celltypes = slc17_celltypes[!slc17_celltypes %in% slc17_and_slc32_celltypes]
slc32_celltypes = slc32_celltypes[!slc32_celltypes %in% slc17_and_slc32_celltypes]

#no celltypes express neither, all express at least one
neither_slc_17_or_32_celltypes = colnames(percent_cluster_exp_gaba_glut)[! colnames(percent_cluster_exp_gaba_glut) %in% c(slc17_celltypes, slc32_celltypes, slc17_and_slc32_celltypes)]
```

Create binary matrix w/info on each np each cluster expresses above threshold separately for 17 vs 32 
```{r}
#subtract threshold from each row and binarize based on if exp >=0 
A<- apply(nps_pseudobulk[,slc17_celltypes], 2,FUN = function(x, y) x = x - y, threshold_exp_each_np)
A = A > 0
unique_clusters = colnames(A)
marker_genes_list_17 <- list()

for(cur_cluster in unique_clusters) {
  # Subset and process as in your code to obtain full_binary_mat for cur_cluster
  genes_cur_cluster <- A[,cur_cluster] %>% .[. == T] %>% names
  other_clusters_binary = A[genes_cur_cluster,!colnames(A) == cur_cluster]
  other_clusters_binary = !other_clusters_binary #T if expressed in this cluster but not other cluster
  full_binary_mat <- 1 * other_clusters_binary
  
  n_genes <- nrow(full_binary_mat)
  n_other <- ncol(full_binary_mat)
  
  model <- MIPModel() %>%
    add_variable(U[j], j = 1:n_genes, type = "binary") %>%
    add_constraint(sum_expr(full_binary_mat[j, k] * U[j], j = 1:n_genes) >= 1, 
                   k = 1:n_other) %>%
    set_objective(sum_expr(U[j], j = 1:n_genes), "min")
  
  result <- solve_model(model, with_ROI(solver = "glpk"))
  solution <- get_solution(result, U[j])
  selected_genes <- rownames(full_binary_mat)[solution$value == 1]
  marker_genes_list_17[[cur_cluster]] <- selected_genes
}
```

For the one celltype expressing both slc17 and slc32, evaluate markers across all
```{r}
#subtract threshold from each row and binarize based on if exp >=0 
A<- apply(nps_pseudobulk, 2,FUN = function(x, y) x = x - y, threshold_exp_each_np)
A = A > 0
unique_clusters = slc17_and_slc32_celltypes
marker_genes_list_others <- list()

for(cur_cluster in unique_clusters) {
  # Subset and process as in your code to obtain full_binary_mat for cur_cluster
  genes_cur_cluster <- A[,cur_cluster] %>% .[. == T] %>% names
  other_clusters_binary = A[genes_cur_cluster,!colnames(A) == cur_cluster]
  other_clusters_binary = !other_clusters_binary #T if expressed in this cluster but not other cluster
  full_binary_mat <- 1 * other_clusters_binary
  
  n_genes <- nrow(full_binary_mat)
  n_other <- ncol(full_binary_mat)
  
  model <- MIPModel() %>%
    add_variable(U[j], j = 1:n_genes, type = "binary") %>%
    add_constraint(sum_expr(full_binary_mat[j, k] * U[j], j = 1:n_genes) >= 1, 
                   k = 1:n_other) %>%
    set_objective(sum_expr(U[j], j = 1:n_genes), "min")
  
  result <- solve_model(model, with_ROI(solver = "glpk"))
  solution <- get_solution(result, U[j])
  selected_genes <- rownames(full_binary_mat)[solution$value == 1]
  marker_genes_list_others[[cur_cluster]] <- selected_genes
}

```

Append glut or gaba name to each cluster id, then add np/recep genes for that cluster
```{r}
names(marker_genes_list_17) = paste0(names(marker_genes_list_17),"_Slc17a6_")
names(marker_genes_list_32) = paste0(names(marker_genes_list_32),"_Slc32a1_")
names(marker_genes_list_others) = paste0(names(marker_genes_list_others),"_Slc17a6_Slc32a1_")
#combine all list
full_marker_list = c(marker_genes_list_17, marker_genes_list_32, marker_genes_list_others)
for(i in 1:length(full_marker_list)) {
  names(full_marker_list)[i] = paste0(names(full_marker_list)[i], paste0(full_marker_list[[i]], collapse = "_"))
}
#create df with internal (numeric id) vs official name
df_internal_and_official_name = data.frame(numeric_id = gsub("^(.*?)_.*", "\\1", names(full_marker_list)), official_name = names(full_marker_list))

#overwrite some with canonical names
canonical_df = data.frame(numeric_cluster_ids = c(2L,4L,13L,15L,19L,40L,41L,44L,54L,55L,100L,101L) %>% as.character(),canonical_name = c("Ghrh_Galanin Neurons", "Gnrh_Kiss1r", "TIDA_Dopaminergic", "Histaminergic","Orexin_Hypocretin","MCH", "Agrp_Npy","Glp1r_Lepr", "Pomc_Cartpt","KNDy", "Avp_Magnocellular","Oxt_Magnocellular")
)

df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[match(canonical_df$numeric_cluster_ids, df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)] = paste0(df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id[match(canonical_df$numeric_cluster_ids, df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)],"_",canonical_df$canonical_name)

#overwrote cluster 51 name manually

write_csv(df_internal_and_official_name, "../shared objs and code/internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")
```
